name: NNA Canonical Convergence
description: Converge 10 scripts / ~25 NNA aggregation sites to one canonical atomic table gold/canonical/nna_atomic/{date}.parquet. Closes the Travis three-way NNA schism, the Snapshot-GEO-NNA TX state-vs-city-vs-distribution gap ($5.39M), and all latent analogues by construction. Five invariants enforced via comp-validate nna_atomic. Every NNA consumer becomes a groupby on this table. Supersedes the GEO three-way point fix (DS brief item #4). DS plan doc: docs/architecture/ADVI_CANNNA_PLAN.md.
